newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo bourse flat the day after record close.
newsitem.headline: Oslo bourse flat the day after record close.

text.p: The Norwegian share index moved within a narrow range on Friday after rising to a life peak the day before.
Oslo's Total share index closed at 1,284,78 points, down 0.3 percent on Thursday's record close. Trade was moderate at 825 million crowns.
On an otherwise quiet day, the index moved briefly after the release of U.S. economic indicators in the afternoon.
"The index reacted a bit on the U.S. indicators, but it was just ripples on the surface," one dealer said.
Industrial group Norsk Hydro, the most traded share at 98 million crowns, closed 0.50 crowns higher at 398 crowns.
Den norske Bank (DnB) and Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse, both of which are expected to present strong first-half 1997 results next week, continued to rise.
DnB closed 0.62 percent, or 0.20 crowns, higher at 32.30 crowns and Christiania was up 1.12 percent, or 0.20 crowns, at 27.10 crowns.
